scenarios.title: No rental still a complete fighter
assertions: All base actions and defense remain executable at zero credits.
No chosen-none slot silently removes an ordinary action.

scenarios.title: Atomic preparation and expiry
assertions: Invalid plans mutate neither wallet.
All rentals expire regardless of winner; no outcome-retained equipment.

scenarios.title: No second resource
assertions: No executable path earns combat money or stores super tickets.
Install/object flags never persist into another round.

scenarios.title: Exact paid thresholds
assertions: Test cost-1, cost, cost+1 with reserve floors.
Illegal startup and active-state reactivation cost zero; committed whiff never refunds.

scenarios.title: Same-slot incompatibility
assertions: Reject two signatures, two techniques or two gambits.
Commands remain unambiguous with every legal loadout.

scenarios.title: Branch and hold timelines
assertions: Earliest/latest/no branch and maximum hold produce explicit recovery.
No reset of input/armor/cancel windows from repeated button edges.

scenarios.title: Super choice and graph
assertions: Only selected art executes.
Overtime graph is HIT-only, acyclic and cannot grant extra rental/throw/EX nodes.

scenarios.title: Field arbitration
assertions: Same-tick destruction/contact/reflection is seat-symmetric.
Single guard-facing rule and major-field cap hold for object-plus-owner attacks.

scenarios.title: Zero-credit funded pressure
assertions: Representative corner/neutral funded states have intended free responses.
Distinguish prior strategic mistakes from a mechanically impossible guard requirement.

scenarios.title: Payout isolation
assertions: No payout change while testing item properties.
Compare the earlier opening-wallet interventions under one fixed content identity.

scenarios.title: Human comprehension
assertions: Players can state what each purchase does and what spending it prevents.
A timed preview never pauses an opponent.

scenarios.title: Actual devices and private peers
assertions: All attack buttons remain in fight, both seat controls independent.
Two physical computers verify the state and debit lifecycle, not only loopback.
